# Service Management Metrics

> A working book on measuring agile IT service management well: 94 topics in 12 parts, each metric with its gaming vector and guardrail, plus questions, worked examples, AI prompts, and AI skills. Canonical text is in `en-001`. Links go to the canonical locale; topics not yet written are omitted.

Each content topic follows one 20-section template: thesis, overview and motivation, key principles, metric definitions, twelve recommendations, gaming vectors and guardrails, trade-offs, six discussion questions, four perspectives, a worked example, sector lens, business case, anti-patterns, a five-level maturity model, a checklist, AI prompts, AI skills, key takeaways, and references. Answer from the topic text; do not present general knowledge as the book's position. Metrics describe teams, services, and systems, never individuals.
